objective: Without tuning the sealed M430 q32 catalog, test whether exact B-way destination multicast improves the catalog advantage when the same B-way destination resource is also granted to strong zero. Reconstruct every M40 phase from raw support once, conserve every destination contribution and persistent old_psum update, and close B>1 before RTL unless it has a material equal-B advantage and defensible throughput/area evidence.

paper_identity.catalog_population: M430 train-only dual-aware q32, frozen before its heldout replay

architecture.phase_boundary: Grouping is strictly inside one sample, one operator and one 16-bit partition/phase; never across a phase, operator, sample or output block.
architecture.destination_identity: The 3000 phase rows are distinct (t,y,x) destination contexts and retain independent old_psum state.
architecture.catalog_correction_group_key: residual source bit j and sign; plus and minus remain separate; fallback original sources are plus only
architecture.issue_rule: For every nonempty group of n destinations, issue exactly ceil(n/B) source reads. Each read broadcasts to at most B independent destination accumulators; tail occupancy is n mod B and no row may be dropped.
architecture.output_blocks: Eight output blocks stay separate, four per tile. A per-block group issue is expanded by eight output-block services; no cross-output-block source-read fusion.
architecture.old_psum: Every PWP and every signed correction/fallback contribution performs one old_psum[destination, output_block] += delta update. PWP does not seed or replace old_psum.
architecture.source_sram: One source/PWP SRAM read per service issue; source SRAM read-port count does not scale with B.
architecture.new_B_dependent_resources: B independent destination accumulator banks/update ports per active 96-lane output block plus destination gather/list storage and B-way broadcast/crossbar. These are not free.

single_pass.failure_policy: Preserve marker and partial output. A recovery may fix only technical analyzer defects under a separately frozen contract; it may not tune the M430 catalog, B axis or decision rule.

decision_rule.go: B>1 may enter RTL only if equal-B catalog speedup versus strong zero improves by at least 5% relative to the B1 catalog advantage, the conservative catalog-throughput/B-accumulator-bank proxy is not below B1, and matched area/power evidence exists.
decision_rule.close_no_advantage: If no B>1 strictly improves equal-B catalog advantage, NO-GO B>1 RTL.
decision_rule.close_resource: Even with cycle improvement, absent defensible matched throughput/area, NO-GO B>1 RTL. The throughput/B proxy is diagnostic rather than real area.

red_lines: Do not change, reorder or tune the sealed M430 catalog from the M40 trace.
Do not group destinations across sample, operator, partition/phase or output block.
Do not floor-divide a tail group; every group uses ceil(count/B) and every destination contribution is serviced exactly once.
Do not fuse destinations algebraically or replace persistent old_psum; each destination/output-block accumulator remains independent.
Do not grant B-way destination hardware only to the catalog path; strong zero receives the same B.
Do not claim the new B accumulator banks, update ports, gather/list storage or crossbar are free.
Do not interpret throughput/B as actual throughput/area without DC/PTPX and physical SRAM/interconnect evidence.
Do not upgrade four-Conv trace cycles to full-network/system, RTL-measured, Synopsys, energy, PPA or DATE headline evidence.
Do not modify docs/359 or sealed upstream evidence.
